details.text:
08
Player protection
Privacy and account safety
The registration page prepares a WhatsApp message on your device; it does not upload the form.
After consent, the match-group message may include only the registration reference, in-game name, and Free Fire UID.
Ages, phone numbers, payment proof, payment addresses, and identity documents stay private and must not be posted in the group.
QW never asks for an OTP, UPI PIN, card PIN, Free Fire password, or account password.
